Hammer unions of different figure numbers must never be joined. The male (thread) half of a 2" Figure 602 or Figure 1002 union will make up into the wing nut of a 2" Figure 1502, so a mismatched joint can look made up and then separate under pressure; IADC records a fatality from a 602-to-1502 mismatch and recommends teaching the differences between union types, go/no-go ring gauges, colour coding and segregated storage.
extraFacts.source: IADC Safety Alerts 06-01 'Mismatched Hammer Union Results in a Fatality' and 03-16 'Mismatched Hammer Unions Still Being Found' (iadc.org/safety-alerts)

faqs.q: What is an API 6A lift check valve used for?

faqs.q: Does the API 6A lift check valve need maintenance?

faqs.q: How should an API 6A swing check valve be installed?
